title: Massive CME event during the Older Dryas

tellings.quote: massive CME event unlike anything that we've ever seen in modern human history hit the earth

plain: During the Older Dryas, a cold spell near the end of the last ice age, the Earth was hit by a huge burst of charged material from the sun, known as a coronal mass ejection, and it was bigger than anything seen in modern human history. A researcher named Matt LaCroix says so, pointing to ice cores drilled in Antarctica but naming no particular study. If true, it would mean a solar catastrophe struck the ancient world around 12,000 BC.
